hero.title: The people behind the barrow
hero.subtitle: Forty years of hot dogs, friendly faces and Cambridge memories. Discover the story of The Hot Sausage Company and our much-loved traditional barrow.

story.title: A little barrow. A big Cambridge story.

paragraphs.origin: Founded by Michael Moran in 1986, The Hot Sausage Company has been bringing people together over hot dogs for four decades. Our Victorian-style barrow is a familiar sight on Fitzroy Street, welcoming everyone from students between lectures to families enjoying a day in Cambridge.
paragraphs.community: Today, Joseph and the team keep that tradition going with satisfying hot dogs, your favourite toppings and a friendly welcome. Whether you're a regular or following the smell of cooked onions for the first time, there's always a place for you at the barrow.
paragraphs.mission: From everyday lunch stops to wedding celebrations, we're proud to be part of Cambridge's street food story.

founded.title: Where it all began
founded.description: Michael Moran founded The Hot Sausage Company, beginning a story of traditional barrows, hot sausages and friendly service.

cambridgeLife.title: Part of Cambridge life
cambridgeLife.description: Lunch breaks, shopping trips and student days: our hot dogs become part of the everyday memories people make in Cambridge.

parties.title: The barrow joins the party
parties.description: Weddings, private parties and corporate gatherings bring a taste of our Cambridge hot dogs to special occasions.

anniversary.title: Forty years, celebrated together
anniversary.description: Our 40th anniversary brings 40 Days of Celebration, with giveaways, familiar faces and new memories at the barrow.

today.title: The story continues
today.description: Find us on Fitzroy Street, explore our merchandise online or enquire about bringing the barrow to your next event.

values.title: Good food. Warm welcomes. Local spirit.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: A satisfying hot dog, prepared with care and finished with the toppings you love. Simple food that keeps you coming back.

tradition.title: Tradition
tradition.description: Our Victorian-style barrow celebrates the character of traditional street food, carrying a Cambridge story forward from 1986.

community.title: Community
community.description: Being part of Fitzroy Street means more than serving hot dogs. From chessboards and games tables that bring people together to litter picks that keep our streets welcoming, we love doing our bit. We also look out for neighbouring businesses, helping make our corner of Cambridge a friendly, safer place for everyone.
